findings.topic: Extra Trees / RF calibration for Brier score
findings.insight: 2025 ScienceDirect: RF with classification-tree base learners outperforms probability-estimation trees on Brier score. OOB Brier score enables direct tree selection, reducing ensemble size without loss. RF_opt calibration beats all post-hoc methods across 30 datasets.
findings.applicability: GA fitness signal should use OOB Brier for Extra Trees / RF selection. Classification-tree base learners preferred in hyperparameter search.

findings.insight: 2025 Scientific Reports + Preprints.org: Rolling efficiency metrics (ORtg, DRtg, TS%, last 5-10 games), win streaks, rest days, home-court dominate SHAP values. Traditional box-score counting stats add minimal marginal value once efficiency metrics included.
findings.applicability: GA feature selector should prioritize rolling efficiency and contextual features. SHAP-guided pruning can trim low-signal features each generation.

findings.topic: Isotonic vs Platt calibration for basketball
findings.insight: Isotonic regression yields equal or better Brier than Platt scaling for >1000 samples (full NBA season). Platt safer for small-sample contexts. Season-to-season distribution shift invalidates both if not re-fit annually.
findings.applicability: Prefer isotonic calibration (already used). Re-fit calibration mapping each season. Use Platt as fallback only for small subsets.
